children: NIIF Infrastructure Finance Limited (NIIF IFL) has raised ₹800 crore through non-convertible debentures (NCDs) carrying an interest rate of 8.48% per annum and a tenure of five years.
With this, the company's total bond mobilisation in November has reached ₹2,600 crore, following an earlier fundraise of ₹1,800 crore during the month, NIIF IFL said in a statement on November 24.
The latest issue saw participation from institutional long-term investors. The company's debt instruments carry AAA ratings from ICRA, CARE Ratings and CRISIL Ratings.

The fundraise comes amid an expansion in the company's lending activity. NIIF IFL reported disbursements of ₹7,888 crore during the first half of FY27, marking a 107% year-on-year increase. Its loan book stood at ₹34,797 crore as of September 30, 2026.
The company reported a net worth of ₹5,237 crore and a net profit of ₹332 crore for the six months ended September 30, 2026.

NIIF IFL provides long-term refinancing to operational infrastructure projects across sectors, including renewable power, roads, transmission, logistics and social infrastructure. It is registered with the Reserve Bank of India as an Infrastructure Debt Fund-NBFC (IDF-NBFC).

Infrastructure Debt Funds are designed to channel long-term capital into operational infrastructure projects. They also provide refinancing avenues for existing lenders, including banks and financial institutions, helping them release capital for fresh lending.
The longer-tenure funding raised by NIIF IFL is intended to support its lending to infrastructure assets, which typically have longer financing requirements.

Ajay Chaudhary, Chief Executive Officer of NIIF Infrastructure Finance Limited, said the company's disbursements more than doubled in the first half of FY27 compared with the corresponding period last year. He added that the latest fundraise would strengthen its long-term funding base.

title: NIIF Infrastructure Finance raises ₹800 crore through NCDs: 5-year tenure, 8.48% interest and other details
